customer.business: Mitra, a free app for Bengaluru creators: paid local deals plus a scam and terms check for every offer you get
customer.target: Creators in and around Bengaluru who post in Kannada and/or English on Instagram (mostly Reels), YouTube or Moj, 2K to 200K followers, food, local lifestyle, comedy or city content, who get brand DMs and want paid work

segments.name: Small creator (2K-10K followers), student or day job, mostly barter offers so far
Growing creator (10K-50K followers), a few paid deals a month at ₹1,000-8,000
Established local creator (50K-200K followers), creating is the main income, may have a manager

behaviours.name: Takes barter happily
behaviours.how: Says yes to free food or a free haircut in exchange for a reel; rarely asks for money.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Once paid a 'registration fee' or posted and never got paid; now ignores most DMs.

behaviours.name: Hustler
behaviours.how: Pitches cafés directly on Instagram and WhatsApp, has a rate card, negotiates.

behaviours.name: Signed up on Influish or similar
behaviours.how: Joined an influencer app, applied to campaigns, got few or none.

behaviours.name: Agency-dependent
behaviours.how: Gets most deals through one or two local agencies or a manager who takes a cut.

behaviours.name: Busy, phone-only
behaviours.how: Shoots and edits on the phone, lives in WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, hates new apps.

objections: Another influencer app that will show me zero real deals
What's the catch if it's free? They'll sell my data or charge me later
Local businesses here only offer barter, not money
I already get DMs; I don't need an app to find offers
Will my followers feel I'm selling out with too many local promos?
I don't trust an app I've never heard of with my contacts and deals
Kannada creators always get paid less than English ones; will this change that?
If a business pays Mitra a fee, they'll pay me less to cover it
habits: you get two or three 'collab' DMs a week and most look fake
you're in a WhatsApp group of Bengaluru food creators who share leads
you edit Reels in CapCut or InShot
you check Instagram insights every morning
you've been paid by UPI for a collab, sometimes weeks late
you post in Kannada and English depending on the audience

pitch:
Mitra: get paid local deals in Bengaluru, and check every collab offer before you reply. In Kannada or English.
Sign in with Google; no need to connect your Instagram or YouTube. Make a media kit in five minutes (connect YouTube if you want a "Verified" badge).
Got a DM or email offer? Paste it, screenshot it or forward it (email or WhatsApp). Mitra tells you if it looks like a scam (registration fees, "buy first, we refund", OTP requests), what's missing (pay, deadline, usage rights) and drafts a reply.
Turn on "Let local businesses find me": cafés, salons and gyms nearby send you paid invites with the fee written down. You accept or decline; your number is shared only when you accept.
Free for creators, always. You keep your whole fee: on deals Mitra brings, the business pays Mitra's fee on top. Mitra never charges you to join, apply or be seen.
Later, an optional Creator Pro with growth tools (video feedback, unlimited screenshot checks, AI replies) will be offered; the price questions below are about what Creator Pro should cost per month in rupees. Getting deals will never be behind it.
